prompt: Choose the best word or sentence for blank [145].
promptZh: 請選出最適合填入第 145 題空格的字詞或句子。

options.text: For example, name the blue pot that appears only on the daylight drawing.
options.zh: 例如，指出只出現在白天格裡的那個藍色花盆。
options.whyZh: 用藍色定位又只在白天出現，和前文的兩格共用、不靠顏色兩條規則皆衝突。

options.text: For example, start with the color of the object, then confirm it in both panels.
options.zh: 例如，先說物件的顏色，再確認它在兩格都出現。
options.whyZh: 用共用物件沒錯，但選色作為辨識依據，不符合入夜外觀改變時的要求。

options.text: For example, describe the outline of a crate that is shown only before dark.
options.zh: 例如，描述只在天黑前那格出現的箱子的外形。
options.whyZh: 外形不靠顏色，但箱子只在白天出現；只看夜景的人找不到。

options.text: For example, refer to the three steps visible in both drawings.
options.zh: 例如，用兩張圖上都看得見的三級台階來定位。
options.whyZh: 數台階不用靠顏色，兩格也都看得見；只看夜景依然能找出位置。

explanationZh: 數台階不用靠顏色，兩格也都看得見；只看夜景依然能找出位置。
evidence: Start each clue with an object that appears in both panels. / If the same object changes appearance after dark, describe a feature that doesn’t depend on its color. / A clue should still work for a reader who sees only the night panel.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Start each clue with an object that appears in both panels.
If the same object changes appearance after dark, describe a feature that doesn’t depend on its color.
A clue should still work for a reader who sees only the night panel.

vocabulary.note: 表示入夜後的時段，不是房間關燈後才必然使用。
